initiative.title: LLM Provider Subscription Auth via CLI Delegation

mission: Users authenticate to LLM providers via their subscriptions through vendor-CLI delegation (t3code methodology): provider instances with isolated HOME dirs, rich auth probes, and zero provider tokens at rest in beep-owned storage.

provenance.note: Partial graduation: only the CLI subscription-auth leg of that exploration's user>CLI>env key-precedence chain graduates here. Dispatch/registry/fallback remain in the exploration. Per-user vault questions stay parked in explorations/ingestion-security-secret-governance.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

stopConditions: Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
The implementation would exceed named scope.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
Any design change would require persisting provider tokens, OAuth codes, or refresh tokens in beep-owned storage.
